process_steps.description: Primary recovery: continuous disk-stack centrifugation followed by depth and sterile filtration; clarifies the broth and defines the feed to Protein A capture. Forms no product-quality attribute and is credited with no impurity clearance; the HCP, DNA and aggregate burden it carries forward is cleared downstream (PCR-005, PCR-007, PCR-008).
equipment: scale-down model of the commercial harvest train

source_references.quote: The step forms no quality attribute of the antibody
The culture fluid leaving the production bioreactor is fed continuously to a disk-stack centrifuge, which sediments cells and the larger cell debris under a centrifugal field.
That material is removed on a train of positively charged depth filters, and the clarified harvest is passed through a sterilising-grade filter into the capture step.

source_references.quote: The characterization was executed on a scale-down model of the commercial harvest operation, qualified under SOP-1001.

statements.statement_text: Harvest and clarification forms no critical quality attribute and reduces none; the attributes formed upstream pass through it unchanged.

source_references.quote: No critical quality attribute of A-Mab responds to a parameter of this step

statements.statement_text: The step recovers 97.7% of the product presented to it in the nominal commercial-scale simulation.

source_references.quote: The step recovered 97.7% of the product mass presented to it and delivered a clarified harvest at 5 NTU at the set-point.

statements.statement_text: Clarification met its in-process expectation across the ranges studied, with a single turbidity excursion above the normal operating range at near-maximum depth-filter loading (DEV-004-02), which was retained.

source_references.quote: Clarification performance was unchanged across the middle and upper part of the centrifugal field range and across the lower part of the depth filter load range.

statements.statement_text: No quality attribute changed across the step: aggregate, charge variants and glycan attributes were the same leaving the step as entering it, at every setting studied.

source_reference.quote: The step forms no quality attribute of the antibody and no clearance of any impurity is claimed for it.
What the step decides is the condition of the load presented to Protein A chromatography.
No quality attribute of the antibody changed measurably across the step at any setting studied.
Both were investigated, both were dispositioned as retained, and neither affected product quality.
This report rolls up into the master report PCMR-001.
It is carried in the parameter list because that material fouls the Protein A column and shortens resin life, so a limit on it is a control on the capture step rather than on this one.
Resin cycling limits at the capture step account for the particulate the clarified harvest carries onto the column, and PCR-005 reports the cycling limit.
Viral clearance is claimed for the low-pH hold, anion exchange and virus filtration, and no viral clearance is claimed for harvest.
A gentle harvest keeps the load close to what left the reactor and a harsh one adds intracellular protein to it.
Aggregate can rise at harvest only if the antibody unfolds at the shear rate of the centrifuge feed zone or at an air-liquid interface created in a foaming transfer.
The step has no mechanism by which it forms or removes a quality attribute of the antibody, so the severity axis of the assessment is low for every parameter
The model does not reproduce the residence time of product in the commercial centrifuge bowl or the hold time of the clarified harvest before capture, and neither was varied in this study.
The model is therefore suitable for establishing the operating ranges of this step, and the conclusions drawn on it are applied directly to the commercial process.
Two bounds on the model apply to every result that follows.
No model was fitted to the data of this study, because the study is univariate and no designed multivariate experiment was performed.

The parameter under study was set in turn to the low edge of its characterized range, to its set-point and to the high edge of its characterized range, and every other parameter was held at its set-point.
It cannot detect an interaction, where the effect of one parameter depends on the level of another
because the feed zone is where cells break and release intracellular protein into the centrate
Turbidity of the clarified harvest rose with load, and the rise was not linear.
As they do, the available media surface falls, and particles that would have been captured early in a batch pass late in the same batch.
The normal operating range of 100 to 140 L/m2 sits below the part of the characterized range where turbidity rises.
In every case the difference between the two was within the precision of the method that measured it.
The depth filter media are positively charged and adsorb a fraction of the DNA and debris the centrifuge passes, so some DNA removal across the filtration stage is expected on mechanistic grounds.

No critical quality attribute of A-Mab responds to a parameter of this step, so there is nothing for such a region to be defined against, and the multivariate studies that would define one were not performed.
Table 7 gives the proven acceptable range of each parameter with the basis on which it is proven.
Each was established with the other parameters held at their set-points, so none of them is a statement about the corners where two parameters are at their edges at once.
The robustness of this step is its own recovery and its own clarification, and both were stable.
The one condition at which performance degraded was high depth filter loading, and what degraded was the turbidity of the clarified harvest.
No parameter of this step is a critical process parameter or a well-controlled critical process parameter.
Turbidity of the clarified harvest rises as loading rises, and the particulate that turbidity measures deposits on the head of the capture column and shortens the number of cycles the resin lot runs.
The attributes in Table 4 are tested at the drug substance and are controlled by the steps that clear them.
The contribution of this step is consolidated in PCMR-001.
No quality attribute of A-Mab was formed, modified or cleared across the step at any condition studied, and no clearance credit and no viral clearance claim is taken for it.
